record_title: Far-field resonance in dominating weighted porous-medium absorption
provenance: A source-specific second-order refinement of the common far-field tail proved for bounded self-similar profiles in arXiv:2609.20397v1. The refinement identifies a universal diffusion-forced regime, a profile-dependent free-mode regime, a logarithmic resonance at m=2p-1, and an exact harmonic cancellation surface.
limitations: The result refines self-similar profile tails and is not a large-time convergence theorem for arbitrary PDE solutions. The profile-dependent free-mode coefficient is not determined from near-origin data, and higher-order terms are not classified when that coefficient vanishes. Older homogeneous-absorption papers remain a residual originality risk because their full texts were not inspected.
